q: What does IKEA require from suppliers on renewable electricity and coal, and what do I need to show?
title: IKEA supplier renewable electricity and coal
short: IKEA's supplier code, IWAY, sets 100 percent renewable electricity as an Advanced criterion, which IKEA said in 2021 would become a minimum later. For Indian textile suppliers it has also called for coal and oil fuels on site to go by 2030 at the latest. Be ready to show electricity, fuel use and renewable supply evidence.
audience: Indian textile, home furnishing, wood and metal suppliers to IKEA

p: IWAY is IKEA's supplier code of conduct; edition 6.0 was published in September 2019. Suppliers must meet every IWAY Must requirement from the first delivery and the Basic requirements within 12 months. Higher criteria, such as Advanced, are expectations IKEA works towards with each supplier.

IKEA said in 2021 that 100 percent renewable electricity was among the Advanced criteria of the new IWAY, not yet mandatory, and that it would become a minimum requirement in future. Check the edition and section you are audited against.

sections.h: Coal and other fossil fuels on site
p: In 2018 IKEA called for coal and oil based fuels to be phased out at its direct textile suppliers in India, Indonesia, Pakistan and Turkey by 2030 at the latest, aiming for 2025. IKEA reports the share of coal and fossil oil fuels used on site in producing its products falling, to 7 percent in FY24. Expect questions about boilers, thermic fluid heaters and kilns burning coal, furnace oil or diesel, and a request for a dated plan to switch them.

ul: Monthly electricity in kWh per site, from discom bills, and the share used for IKEA production if you serve other buyers.
Fuel use by type, from invoices, with a Scope 1 total.
Renewable supply documents: rooftop solar generation records, open access or group captive energy accounts, green tariff bills, or certificates retired for you.
Location-based and market-based Scope 2 shown separately, so the renewable claim is traceable.

p: In 2021 IKEA launched a renewable electricity programme for direct suppliers in China, India and Poland, offering pre-negotiated power purchase and framework agreements, and later added more countries. Ask your IKEA contact what it offers for your state and site before you sign your own contract.

example.title: Worked example: what a supplier shows for one year (illustrative)
lines: Grid electricity: 12,00,000 kWh x 0.710 = 8,52,000 kg CO2 location-based
Rooftop solar used on site: 3,00,000 kWh, not drawn from the grid
Coal boiler: 800 t x 2.42 kg CO2 per kg = 19,36,000 kg CO2 Scope 1, the item to plan out
example.note: Figures are illustrative. Use your own bills, generation meter and fuel invoices.
